Review DeckSpeed?

DeckSpeed earns strong praise for speed, polish, and time savings. Reviewers say it feels like a helpful teammate or consultant, producing impressive decks from minimal input and streamlining workflows. Users highlight useful data visualization, customization, and smooth handling of private data via MCP, with several noting quality results within seconds.
